leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a TypeScript type definition from a provided schema object.
Apply mapped types to transform schema property types into TypeScript types.
Implement a generic type mapper function that accepts a schema and returns its corresponding type.
Configure the mapper to handle nested schema structures recursively.
Integrate the type mapper with a sample data object to enforce type safety.
Manipulate the schema to add optional properties and update the derived type accordingly.
Initialize a TypeScript project and configure tsconfig.json for strict type checking relevant to the mapper.
